library_construction_protocol: We performed the Cut&Tag experiments according to the manufacturer's instructions (Vazyme, cat. no. TD901-TD902). HeLa Cells were harvested, counted, and centrifuged for 3 mins at 600g at RT. Aliquots of cells (about 100000 cells) were washed twice in 1.5 mL Wash Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM Spermidine, 1×Protease inhibitor cocktail) by gentle pipetting. 10 μL of Concanavalin A beads (Bangs Laboratories) were activated and added to each sample. The mixture was rotated and incubated for 15 mins at RT. The supernatant was removed and bead-bound cells were resuspended in 50 μL Dig-wash Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM Spermidine, 1× Protease inhibitor cocktail, 0.05% Digitonin) containing 2 mM EDTA and a 1:50 dilution of primary antibodies. The incubation was rotated for 2 h at RT. Then primary antibodies were removed by pulling off all of the supernatants after placing the tube on the magnet stand. The second antibody (goat anti-Rabbit IgG) was diluted 1:50 in 50 μL of Dig-Wash buffer and incubated at RT for 30 mins. Cells were washed 3× for 5 mins in 800 μL Dig-Wash buffer to remove unbound antibodies. A 1:200 pG-Tn5 adapter complex (~0.04 μM) was prepared in Dig-300 Buffer (0.05% Digitonin, 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 300 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM Spermidine, 1×Protease inhibitor cocktail) and added to cells. Then cells were rotated and incubated with transposase at RT for 1 h. Cells were washed 3× for 5 min in 800 μL Dig-300 Buffer to remove unbound pG-Tn5 protein. Next, cells were resuspended in 100 μL Tagmentation buffer (10 mM MgCl2 in Dig-300 Buffer) and incubated at 37 °C for 1 h. 10 μL of 0.5 M EDTA, 3 μL of 10% SDS and 2.5 μL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K was added to the sample, which was incubated at 55 °C for 60 min to stop tagmentation. Then the total DNA was extracted using Phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 25:24:1 (Invitrogen, cat. no. 15593049). To amplify libraries, 21 μL DNA was mixed with 2 μL of a uniquely barcoded i5 and an i7 primer, (Vazyme, cat. no. TD202) using a different barcode for each sample. A volume of 25 μL NEBNext HiFi 2×PCR Master mix was added and mixed. The sample was placed in a Thermocycler with a heated lid using the following cycling conditions: 72 °C for 5 min (gap-filling) 98 °C for 30 s 14 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s and 63 °C for 30 s final extension at 72 °C for 1 min and hold at 4 °C.
